newsVersionExact: OpenAI announced September 16 that it is testing Sponsored Agents with select US advertisers.
actualMeaningExact: You are talking to a seller about what it offers, through an AI agent inside ChatGPT.
mechanismExact: After clicking an ad in ChatGPT, a person can choose to open a clearly labelled conversation with an agent sponsored by that business.
familiarExampleExact: Imagine an ad for a desk lamp catches your eye.

jargon.plainMeaning: “Sponsored” tells you who is paying for the conversation.

learningConnections.concept: Commercial incentives shape what a speaker wants you to do
learningConnections.learningPayoff: Ask who is speaking and what incentive sits behind a claim.
